transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Good morning, this is Karan from Udaan Credit Finance.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: This call is recorded for quality and compliance.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Am I speaking with Ms. Priya Menon?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes, this is Priya speaking.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: For verification, could you please tell me your date of birth?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Sure, it's the 9th of March, 1989.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for confirming.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm calling to remind you that your personal loan EMI of 9,200 rupees is

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's due on the 5th.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Actually, this month is a bit heavy for me.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: My daughter just got admission in an engineering college and I have to arrange her fees next month.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Will the EMI be paid through auto-debit as usual?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes, the auto-debit is fine.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Also my son wants a scooter for college,

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: So we are thinking of buying a second two-wheeler soon.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Okay, man.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Please keep sufficient balance in your account one day before the due date.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Sure, I will do that.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your time. Have a nice day.

nudges.label: Payment difficulty
nudges.text: Show empathy (“this month is a bit heavy for me”). Offer the approved path: hardship review / Customer Assistance callback. Don't ask them to borrow.
evidence: this month is a bit heavy for me
